review.note: defaults for the round-review workflow; resolved by workflow.py run review --harness pi with --args overriding; config-maxxed so it can run on any harness (hypothesis:l3w4-workflows-config-maxxed), 2026-09-07. 'sonnet' is correct HERE because provider is claude-code, whose model namespace is subscription aliases, not OpenRouter slugs (hypothesis:l3-workflow-model-crosses-harness-namespace).
